I've tried a lot of clay masks over the years, and this one is definitely one of my favorites. It goes on smoothly, doesn't feel overly tight as it dries, and leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean without stripping away all the moisture. After rinsing, my pores looked smaller, my skin felt softer, and I noticed a nice healthy glow. I use it about once or twice a week, especially when my skin feels congested or oily, and it does a great job drawing out impurities. Even with mature, postmenopausal skin, I didn't find it overly drying. A little goes a long way, so the jar lasts a while. If you're looking for a clay mask that deep cleans while leaving your skin feeling refreshed and smooth, I would definitely recommend giving this one a try.
